title: See who did what
text: Activity Logs shows what happened in your shop, who did it, and when. You cannot edit or delete these records.
steps: The newest entries appear first. Scroll down to load older entries.
Use the colored dots to identify the action: green means added, blue means edited, red means removed, and amber means signed out.

title: Find one entry
text: Search Activity Logs by user, product, action, or date.
steps: Type a name, product, action, or date in the search box.
Use the User and Type filters to narrow the results.
Click Refresh to see the latest entries.

title: Check one staff member or one shift
text: Filter Activity Logs by staff member, log type, and date.
steps: Under All Users, choose a staff member.
Under All Logs, choose Management for office changes or Cashier for register activity.
Click Select Period and choose a preset or enter a start and end date.

title: Download the history
text: Download all records that match your search and filters.
steps: Set the user, type, and date filters you need.
Click Download above the activity list.
Choose Export as Excel or Download as Text.

title: Logs for another branch or all branches
text: View activity from one branch or all branches.
steps: Click the branch name at the top of the page and choose a branch or All Branch.
